results.title: Indian 'Dhurandhar' in Pakistan cricket team? Mike Hesson’s 'loyalty' questioned over IPL links
results.description: Pakistan's worsening crisis has now triggered questions over Mike Hesson's loyalty, with former captain Rashid Latif raising concerns about the New Zealander's previous work in the Indian Premier League.

results.title: India Unfazed by Final Opponent: Confidence High for T20 Asia Cup Clash
results.description: In an assured display of confidence Indias womens cricket team remains unfazed by their prospective opponents in the Womens T20 Asia Cup final all set to unfold on Sunday All-rounder Deepti Sharma emphasized Indias strategy of preparedness regardless of facing either Pakistan or defending champions Sri Lanka Indias track record is impressive having secured a spot in the final for the sixth consecutive time by triumphing over Bangladesh in the semi-final clash

results.title: Asian Games: China basketball stars packed in 3 to a container in Japan’s athletes’ village
results.description: China’s men opened their Asian Games basketball campaign by routing Kazakhstan 99-61 on Friday, despite preparing in cramped container housing and having training disrupted by record-breaking rainfall in Japan. Pang Zhenglin led China with 19 points and four assists, while Li Hongquan recorded 16 points and nine rebounds.
